games.name: Dungeon Combat Die
games.author: draugvar
games.description: A six-sided combat die for dungeon crawls: three skulls, two shields and one critical bolt. Inspired by classic dungeon-crawl combat dice, built from SF Symbols.

games.name: Elemental Dice
games.author: draugvar
games.description: Six elemental faces - fire, water, air, earth, storm and frost - for resolution tables and elemental challenges.

games.name: Fate / Fudge Dice
games.author: draugvar
games.description: Four Fudge/Fate dice with plus, blank and minus faces, built from SF Symbols.

games.name: Geometric Runes
games.author: draugvar
games.description: Six original geometric rune glyphs embedded as base64 images; shows the embedded-image workflow.

games.name: Playtest Dice
games.author: draugvar
games.description: Weighted resolution die for game designers: 50% failure, 33% success, 17% critical. Handy for tabletop prototypes and probability checks.

games.name: Zombie Horde Dice
games.author: draugvar
games.description: Classic zombie survival combat dice: a shambling zombie on the 1, dynamite on the 6 and pips for 2-5. Roll your dice and count results against the weapon's accuracy.
